projects.title: Life and pensions policy platform migration
projects.summary: Moved a Java monolith with an Oracle database and 38 overnight batch jobs to Azure in four releases. Batch was re-expressed as event-driven services with a scheduled fallback; the batch window fell from five hours to about one. Stored-procedure logic was the largest single source of variance against the original estimate.

projects.title: Claims intake portal and legacy service facade
projects.summary: Customer-facing intake portal with document upload, fronting an unchanged on-premises claims system through an API gateway that exposed REST over existing SOAP contracts. Customer identity was delivered with a managed external identity service rather than a custom build.

projects.title: Grocery order and inventory integration hub
projects.summary: Fourteen interfaces between an ERP, an e-commerce storefront, a warehouse provider and a data warehouse. Event-driven order and stock flows with scheduled file exchanges, a replay console for operators and a daily three-way reconciliation. Partner file-format changes drove two of the three schedule slips.

projects.title: Wholesale distributor EDI and partner onboarding
projects.summary: Managed SFTP and AS2 endpoints, EDI translation, and a self-service partner onboarding flow with test harness. Partner-side readiness, not build effort, set the critical path; onboarding ran for eleven weeks after the platform was complete.

projects.title: Field service agent-assist assistant
projects.summary: Retrieval over 1,800 manuals and six years of work orders, with drafted responses reviewed by an engineer before sending. Roughly a third of the effort went to ingestion, chunking strategy and an evaluation set rather than to the application. Deterministic rules kept priority and entitlement decisions out of the model.

projects.title: Document classification and intake automation
projects.summary: Document extraction and classification with a confidence threshold that routed low-confidence items to a human queue. Accuracy targets were agreed against a labelled sample before build started, which avoided a scope dispute at acceptance.
